name: nanoclaw
label: NanoClaw
description: Containerized agent runtime — each Agent Group runs in its own Docker container (Claude Agent SDK). Bridged to the Workspace via a native OpenAgents channel.

install.macos: echo 'NanoClaw is an external containerized runtime. Set it up from https://github.com/nanocoai/nanoclaw (clone, pnpm install, ./nanoclaw.sh setup), symlink bin/ncl onto your PATH, then install the OpenAgents channel: see docs/nanoclaw.md (/add-openagents).'
install.linux: echo 'NanoClaw is an external containerized runtime. Set it up from https://github.com/nanocoai/nanoclaw (clone, pnpm install, ./nanoclaw.sh setup), symlink bin/ncl onto your PATH, then install the OpenAgents channel: see docs/nanoclaw.md (/add-openagents).'
install.windows: echo 'NanoClaw requires Docker Desktop + WSL2 on Windows. Set it up inside WSL2 from https://github.com/nanocoai/nanoclaw, symlink bin/ncl onto your PATH, then install the OpenAgents channel: see docs/nanoclaw.md (/add-openagents).'

check_ready.not_ready_message: Set NANOCLAW_AGENT_GROUP (and NANOCLAW_HOME) — press e to configure

env_config.name: NANOCLAW_HOME
env_config.description: Path to your NanoClaw checkout (optional if `ncl` is on PATH)

env_config.name: NANOCLAW_AGENT_GROUP
env_config.description: NanoClaw Agent Group id or name to bridge to this agent
